item.title: Zoho Projects
item.description:
Automate repetitive project management tasks, streamline workflows, and track progress effortlessly to deliver faster and smarter.
With Zoho Projects automation, you can:

  • Automatically assign tasks to the right team members based on skills or workload
  • Set up recurring tasks and milestones to save time
  • Track every stage of your project timeline in real time
  • Get instant alerts on task updates, comments, and deadline changes
  • Automate reminders, follow-ups, and dependency updates
  • Generate detailed project reports without manual effort

By connecting tasks, teams, and timelines, you can ensure accurate planning, faster execution, and seamless project delivery.
Spend less time on admin work and more time focusing on delivering projects that drive results.

item.title: Zoho SalesIQ
item.description:
Engage website visitors, capture leads, and provide instant support with Zoho SalesIQ.
With Zoho SalesIQ, you can:

  • Track and identify visitors in real time on your website or app
  • Initiate live chats based on visitor activity or location
  • Use intelligent bots to qualify leads and answer common questions 24/7
  • Segment visitors and route chats to the right sales or support team
  • Integrate with CRM to log visitor interactions automatically
  • Get detailed reports on visitor engagement and chat performance

By combining live chat, visitor tracking, and automation, you can convert more prospects, deliver better customer experiences, and grow your sales pipeline efficiently.

item.title: Zoho Desk
item.description:
Deliver exceptional customer service across email, live chat, phone, social media, and more — all from one unified platform.
With Zoho Desk, your support teams can:

  • Manage tickets from multiple channels in a single interface
  • View complete customer history and past interactions instantly
  • Automate ticket assignments, escalations, and follow-ups
  • Use AI-powered suggestions to respond faster and smarter
  • Track team performance with advanced analytics and dashboards
  • Provide self-service options via a knowledge base, FAQs, and community forums

By streamlining customer service processes and integrating with other Zoho apps, you can resolve issues faster, boost customer satisfaction, and build long-term relationships.

item.title: Zoho CRM
item.description:
Harness the power of data to drive your sales strategy with Zoho CRM Analytics & Insights.
With Zoho CRM, you can:

  • Monitor lead generation, conversion rates, and deal progress in real time
  • Track sales pipelines, forecast revenue, and identify top-performing products
  • Access AI-powered dashboards for predictive sales insights
  • Segment customers based on purchase behavior and engagement history
  • Analyze sales team performance to improve productivity
  • Spot bottlenecks and optimize every stage of the customer journey

From prospecting to closing, Zoho CRM’s analytics ensure every decision is backed by actionable insights.
